traceability.notes:
The core logic for this story is largely implemented and well unit-tested at the helper level: CatchClause handling in gatherBranchCommentText now supports both before-catch and inside-catch annotation positions with correct priority and fallback, and getBranchAnnotationInfo plus reportMissingAnnotations insert auto-fix annotations inside the catch body at the first statement, which aligns with Prettier’s behavior. These behaviors are covered by new tests in tests/utils/branch-annotation-catch-position.test.ts and tests/utils/branch-annotation-catch-insert-position.test.ts, and all existing require-branch-annotation rule tests (including catch scenarios) still pass, so there are no regressions.
However, not all acceptance criteria and Definition-of-Done items are satisfied: - There is no integration test that actually runs Prettier and then ESLint on a formatted try/catch example to prove "Prettier Compatibility" and "Integration test with actual Prettier-formatted code". - The rule documentation (docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md) still only describes comments immediately preceding branches and does not mention the alternative inside-catch position or any Prettier compatibility notes, failing the "Documentation" acceptance criterion and the documentation part of the DoD.
Because these user-facing and verification requirements are not fully met, the story cannot be considered fully implemented and is assessed as FAILED.
